description: Protect a Word .docx document in one call: set an open password (Agile AES-256 encryption, opens in Microsoft Word / WPS / LibreOffice), add a native Word text watermark, add copyright info (author/custom property/footer), clean privacy metadata, and restrict editing (read-only / comments only / tracked changes only / forms, optionally password-protected). Returns the protected .docx as base64 plus a summary of applied operations. Max input 20MB base64. Privacy: when called remotely (Streamable HTTP / SSE) the file is uploaded to the DocMorph server and processed in memory only; it is not written to disk or retained after processing, and passwords and file contents are never logged. When the MCP server runs locally over stdio, the file is processed entirely on this machine.

base64Docx.description: Base64 encoded .docx binary data (or data URI). May be an already encrypted .docx if currentPassword is given

cleanPrivacy.description: Whether to clean privacy metadata ('true' or 'false', default 'false'). Cleans the items in privacyItems

copyrightAuthor.description: Optional author name written to the document properties (dc:creator / lastModifiedBy)

copyrightFooter.description: Optional copyright line appended to the footer of every section

copyrightText.description: Optional copyright notice stored as the custom document property 'Copyright'

currentPassword.description: Only if the input .docx is already password-protected: its current open password, used to unlock it before processing

fileName.description: Original filename (e.g. report.docx); used to name the output file

openPassword.description: Optional open password to encrypt the output with (applied last). Omit to leave the file openable without a password

privacyItems.description: Comma-separated privacy items to clean: author, timestamps, company, customProps, reviewers, or 'all' (default: 'author,company,reviewers'). Setting it implies cleanPrivacy

restrictEditing.description: Restrict editing in Word: readOnly, comments (comments only), trackedChanges (tracked changes only), forms (filling in forms) (default: 'none')

restrictPassword.description: Optional password required to stop the editing restriction in Word (only with restrictEditing). Without it anyone can stop protection

watermarkFontFamily.description: Watermark font family (default: SimSun for Chinese, MS Mincho for Japanese, otherwise Calibri)

watermarkFontSize.description: Watermark font size in pt (8-200), or 'auto' to fit the page width (default: 'auto')

watermarkText.description: Optional watermark text (max 100 chars), e.g. 'CONFIDENTIAL'. Omit for no watermark. Replaces any existing Word watermark

name: word_protect
